messages:
mike: Heads-up: customer onboarding hit token refresh parity issue between ruby and node. Ruby retries once and fails streams. Node retries twice. Anyone recall intended default?

norah: That doesn't sound right. Which gem tag/rc are you on?

mike: 0.11.0 (released). Using sampleapp with metadata provider. Repro is trivial: start sampleapp, then block metadata for ~1.5s during an active stream. Ruby closes the stream with 401 after a single refresh attempt.

jen: We intentionally tightened streaming retry defaults in the recent change to reduce duplicate generations. Looks like auth-refresh attempts got folded into that limit too. That was accidental.

mike: Filed issue #10001 with a minimal repro script and logs (attached).

ci-bot: Issue created: #10001 by mike. Labels: sdk/ruby, severity/high.

docs-bot: Quick docs note: onboarding guide currently lacks guidance for slow metadata servers. Recommend adding REDWOOD_FAKE_TOKEN_DELAY env var for local repro and a short troubleshooting snippet.

norah: Temporary workaround for customers: configure the client explicitly: `Redwood::Client.new(api_key: provider, retry: { auth_refresh_attempts: 3, max_attempts: 5 })`. Works in my local CI.

jen: I'll open a small PR to (1) restore auth_refresh_attempts default for streams to 2, (2) add REDWOOD_FAKE_TOKEN_DELAY + REDWOOD_DEBUG_RETRY to sampleapp/README, and (3) add an integration test with a fake metadata server that delays token fetch. Tagging @norah for review.

mike: Please also add a short quickstart blurb: how to enable verbose retry logs (`export REDWOOD_DEBUG_RETRY=1`) and how to set token fetch timeout. That'll save support time.

jen: PR 4200 opened: branch jen/stream-auth-retry-fix. Includes changelog, test, and sampleapp doc changes.

ci-bot: CI started for jen/stream-auth-retry-fix (ruby-matrix). Integration job "stream-auth-refresh" scheduled.

mike: Thanks all. I'll verify with the customer once merged and paste results here.
